automated_tests.skip_reason: The local test environment does not have the optional torch dependency.

conclusion: The bounded retry mechanism and fallback are implemented and unit-tested. Runtime review remains opt-in: this small pilot did not establish a quality gain, and the 4B reviewer is the same model as the answer generator. The graph produced the reliable relationship answer after a real LLM-judge miss.
limitations: Small hand-authored question set; no independent human quality labels.
Latency samples were not randomized or run under controlled model warm-up.
The live judge did not successfully request a retrieval retry during this pilot; retrieval retry behavior is covered by deterministic unit tests.
